Several papers address transformer recommender popularity bias directly. The closest match is a 2026 paper on scaling transformer-based sequential recommenders, which finds that larger transformer models improve accuracy but also amplify popularity bias, and proposes SPRINT to reduce that effect by constraining attention and feed-forward norms [1]. Another transformer-based sequential recommendation paper introduces BT-SR, which says it mitigates popularity bias and improves long-tail coverage without negative sampling [8].

If you mean broader popularity-bias mitigation in recommenders, there are also papers on sequential recommendation losses and denoising [3, 9], but [1] is the most directly about transformer recommender scaling and popularity bias.
